svg.text: ESP32-P4 case — sketch v5 (honeycomb lid on inside tabs)
BASE (one part): back plate + all four walls + standoffs
LID: honeycomb grille plate, 4 corner tabs
A. Front (as seen on the wall)
shaded = corner tabs under the lid (snaps + guide pins)
dashed = lid tabs inside the wall
B. Cable end (bottom on the wall)
board drops in tilted: connectors into the holes first
H. Header end (top on the wall)
ribbon / jumper wires leave through the slot
Sketch only — approximate (mm). Amber = openings, blue dashed = parts inside, green dashed = board.
